name: Cubes on the Bayside Summer 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdmhSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--870d76ef713f4edc5223895d9e286e7c18138874/Mid_Atlantic_Logo.png) This competition is being held in the Mid-Atlantic Region (DC, DE, MD, NJ, NY, PA, VA, WV).
